custom_expected:
Step 2: Customers nav is blocked (denied page or hidden nav item).
Step 3: Work Orders create flow is accessible.
Step 4: Customer picker is FUNCTIONAL — the user CAN select a customer even though Customer Management View is OFF. This is the explicit v10 Key Decision: feature access (can I open the Customers page?) is separate from data access (can a WO form pick a customer record?).
Step 6: WO is created with the selected customer attached. This is correct behavior, not a permission leak.
custom_preconds: Custom role 'WO Creator No Cust' has: Work Orders View+Create&Edit ON, but Customer Management View OFF (and Create&Edit OFF, Delete OFF). Test user assigned.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as test user.
  2. Go to top nav > Customers.
  3. Go to top nav > Work Orders. Click 'Create Work Order' or equivalent.
  4. On the new WO form, attempt to select a customer (the customer picker field).
  5. Search and select an existing customer.
  6. Save the WO.
title: Feature access does NOT imply data access — user without Customers View can still pick a customer when creating a WO
